title: Von Däniken's ancient astronaut reading of the Nazca Lines
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Von Däniken's ancient astronaut reading of the Nazca Lines, about 100-800 CE at Nazca, Peru, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Erich von Däniken, author of Chariots of the Gods, thought that they were tributes to ancient alien astronauts and extraterrestrial group that seeded human civilization.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how the writer Erich von Däniken, author of a book called Chariots of the Gods, explained the Nazca Lines, giant markings on the ground at Nazca in Peru. As Michels puts it, von Däniken thought the lines were tributes to ancient alien astronauts, a group from another world that he believed got human civilization started. If that were so, our earliest cultures would have had help from outside Earth.
